sceneStatus: Real geographic terrain, 15 viewing destinations and explicitly approximate landmark meshes; not a complete photogrammetric reconstruction.

coordinateSystem.axes: X UTM grid east, Y up, Z grid south
coordinateSystem.scale: UTM grid metres, no DEM elevation exaggeration; classified well/cave detail replaces the coarse local surface, not a measured elevation correction.
coordinateSystem.vertical: Visual sea Y=0; original Skadi composite retained. Coast taper and local reference-model well/cave floors are visual approximations; source vertical datum not independently certified.
coordinateSystem.datumAlignment: Only WGS84-derived sources. No GCJ-02/BD-09 overlay. Map projection convergence is retained.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.classification: 数据准确还原（相对于源数据；无测绘精度担保）
sources.use: Closed coastline rings, mapped road centerlines, building footprints, landuse/beaches, place names and wind generator nodes.
sources.method: Merge original XML by ID, join coastlines by exact endpoint node IDs, select the ring containing the local origin; project to UTM50N. No invented closing segment. Retain 3779 main-coast vertices. One unclosed context coast omitted. Intertidal beach polygons are retained even when their centroid is outside the coastline. 52 mapped beach polygons are displayed separately; OSM coastline is not changed.
sources.accuracy: Community database; positional precision varies and is not independently measured. Coverage is incomplete: 394 main-island building footprints, only two in Beigang. Road width and untagged building heights are estimated.

sources.title: Mapzen / Tilezen Skadi, USGS terrain data
sources.license: Underlying USGS SRTM / GMTED public terrain data; credit USGS and Mapzen. See Tilezen source-specific attribution.
sources.classification: 数据准确还原（公开格网采样）
sources.resolution: 3601×3601 samples per 1 degree tile, 1 arcsecond, approximately 28×31 metres near Pingtan. Output at 40m; distant LOD 80/160m.
sources.accuracy: Sample spacing is not positional or vertical accuracy. Composite source mapping not independently audited. Canopy/building artifacts possible. Not bare-earth LiDAR.
sources.modifications: Bilinear UTM sampling. Keep raw elevations in elevation-raw.f32; visual surface has coast taper ~85m, minimum positive land height .08m and ocean floor -3m. Sea and floor are not tidal/bathymetric measurements. A separate water-field combines the unchanged shoreline mask with mapped exposed beach polygons solely for visual water-edge/foam shading. Beach mesh uses the LOD height envelope +0.38m to prevent terrain overlap; no measured tidal height is asserted.
sources.epoch: Tile object last modified 2016-04-28; underlying SRTM observations circa 2000; composite source age varies.

sources.title: EOxCloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH, modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016
sources.license: CC BY 4.0, specifically original 2016 s2cloudless layer
sources.verification: research/eox-capabilities.xml explicitly declares the s2cloudless layer year 2016 and CC BY 4.0. Later annual layers have other terms and are not used.
sources.classification: 数据准确还原（历史影像分布）
sources.resolution: Original Sentinel-2 visible bands nominal 10m; WMS output about 13×14m; UTM texture 2048×3072 about 14m, low texture 1024×1536.
sources.modifications: Inverse UTM geographic remap, nearest sampling, WebP encoding; low variant downsampled. Near-camera procedural grains are material approximations, not added image detail.
sources.accuracy: Annual composite, not current imagery or drone photogrammetry. Some clouds and historic reclamation mismatches remain. No rooftop heights are derived from pixels.

sources.accuracy: Two OSM hotel footprints retain coordinates and outline. Facades are generic local stone-house types, not an asserted recreation of those specific hotels. Height 6m and roof details are estimated. Sample paving, wall and shrubs are not surveyed.
